routeContract.method: All authored full campaigns, sorted by filename; exact final state, canonical final prose and visible dialogue rows. Raw state-bearing baseline stays outside Git.

artDecision: Reuse all four complete existing 3:2 paintings. Desktop pairs art and prose; phones lead with prose. No additional closure, permission, source transfer or care is depicted. Each scene has an explicit updated decision in scene-art.json.
voiceDecision: All exact displayed quotations, actual actors, binding order and deliveries remain byte-identical. Afterword and history are unvoiced. Saved manual, mute, zero voice volume and paragraph preferences remain authoritative.
audioDecision: Retain Ward score for names/witness/listed, quiet score for quiet and Ward ambience. Closing focus multiplies saved music by 65% and ambience by 55%, alongside existing speech ducking. Voice/effects levels stay independent; departure restores normal scene direction. No new media.
accessibilityDecision: Compact speaker and visible goal precede the complete scene. Personal afterword follows, then separate native disclosures for factual aftermath and chapter/resource history. Canonical prose appears once. No forced wait, automatic choice or speech-driven focus/scroll. Text-only and missing-art play stay complete.
